## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe one focused change and link the issue/proposal when applicable.

## Verification

Actual commands, results, source/package identity and untested limits. Distinguish builds/tests from listening and DAW checks. No public PR is entitled to execution on the maintainer's PC.

## Rights and privacy

Identify original/third-party material and its license/provenance. Confirm attachments exclude credentials, private projects and uncleared audio. Original contributions use AGPL-3.0-only; no copyright assignment is requested.
